html:
G'oya

Sanadan oyni ajratib olib, uni 5 bilan solishtirasiz. Saralash uchun esa oyning kuni kerak, butun sana emas: ro'yxatda yil hech qanday rol o'ynamaydi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT id, name, birth_date
FROM employees
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM birth_date) = 5
ORDER BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM birth_date), id
Faqat SQLiteSELECT id, name, birth_date
FROM employees
WHERE strftime('%m', birth_date) = '05'
ORDER BY strftime('%d', birth_date), id

birth_date NULL bo'lsa, oy ham NULL chiqadi va shart rost bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun bunday xodimlar o'zi tushib qoladi. SQLite'da strftime('%d') ikki xonali matn ('03', '17'), matn sifatida ham to'g'ri saralanadi.

Tuzoqlar

ORDER BY birth_date sanani avval yil bo'yicha saralaydi. 1985-05-28 da tug'ilgan xodim 2001-05-02 da tug'ilgandan oldin chiqadi, lekin tabriklash ro'yxatida 2-may birinchi bo'lishi kerak:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, name, birth_date
FROM employees
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM birth_date) = 5
ORDER BY birth_date, id

SQLite'da strftime('%m', birth_date) = 5 xato bermaydi, lekin hech kimni topmaydi: strftime matn qaytaradi va '05' matni 5 soniga teng emas. '05' deb yozing yoki natijani CAST(... AS INTEGER) bilan songa aylantiring.

LIKE '%05%' ham to'g'ri emas: 1990-03-05 (5-mart) va 2005-yilda tug'ilganlar ham topiladi.

Boshqa yo'l

Sana matnga aylantirilsa (1990-05-17), oy 6-7 belgilar, kun 9-10 belgilar. Bu ikkala bazada ishlaydi:

SELECT id, name, birth_date
FROM employees
WHERE SUBSTR(CAST(birth_date AS TEXT), 6, 2) = '05'
ORDER BY SUBSTR(CAST(birth_date AS TEXT), 9, 2), id
